# ANALYSIS: VIX_PULLBACK_LONG_OOS_VALIDATION

## Hypothesis

VIX pullback long strategy attempts to capture bullish mean-reversion entries when VIX pulls back from elevated levels. The hypothesis is that VIX mean-reversion combined with SPY support holds produces positive expectancy on 0DTE calls. This analysis validates whether the strategy clears OP-16 edge_capture >= 771 and concentration <= 50% across 2025-Q3 + 2026-Q1.

## Mechanism

Entry: VIX pulls back from >=18 to <=17.20 (or falling) while SPY tests a defined support level (premarket low, ascending trendline, horizontal support). Trigger requires bullish EMA ribbon flip + level reclaim candle. Exit: chart-stop primary (close below reclaimed level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (arm +5%, trail 15%), premium catastrophe cap (-50% Safe / -5% Bold), time stop 15:50 ET. TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner rides ribbon.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Stage-1 BS-sim uses qty=3 (min contracts). At ~$1.50 entry premium, $450/trade = 45% of $1K paper. Live would need $2.5K+ for 3-contract min at ITM strikes.
2. **Sample bias:** 6 quarters (2025-Q1 through 2026-Q2), 225 trades. Strategy only fires on bull setups -- zero coverage of J's 3 PUT anchor winners. Selection method: single combo from kitchen runner, no parameter sweep. High overfit risk (single combo, no WF validation yet).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS -- Stage-1 only ran IS+OOS combined (wide_pnl = -$1,464). No walk-forward split executed. Quarter breakdown shows 2/6 positive (2025-Q2 +$770, 2026-Q1 +$1,549; others negative).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS -- Stage-1 used BS-synthetic pricing (black_scholes with VIX/100 IV proxy). Per L23, BS-sim systematically overestimates ITM entry premiums by 10-25%. Real OPRA fills required before any ratification.
5. **Failure modes:** Max drawdown $4,701 (4.7x account at $1K). Wide WR 18.7% -- 81% of trades lose. Top-5 days = 999% of P&L (extreme concentration -- other days net negative). Worst quarter 2025-Q3 -$1,135. Blow-up scenario: sustained low-VIX trending market (like Nov-Dec 2025 per L30 SNIPER post-mortem) where pullback entries get stopped out repeatedly.
6. **Concentration:** top5_pct = 999.0% (FAILS <=50% gate). Only 2/6 quarters positive. Edge_capture = 759.21 (FAILS >=771 floor -- misses 4/29 and 5/01 PUT winners entirely).

## Pre-merge gate

REJECTED at door -- fails OP-16 edge_capture floor (759.21 < 771) and concentration gate (999% >> 50%). Would need: (1) walk-forward OOS split with WF >= 0.70, (2) real-fills validation on top-3 anchor days (diff < 20% vs BS-sim), (3) parameter sweep showing stable edge_capture >= 771 across combos, (4) concentration <= 50% in OOS window. None of these exist.

## Confidence

1 / 10 -- Strategy structurally cannot capture J's 3 PUT anchor winners (edge_capture ceiling = 5/04 + 5/07 partials = ~$880 max theoretical). Stage-1 achieved 759.21 but with negative wide_pnl, 18.7% WR, and 999% concentration. No path to OP-16 compliance without capturing PUT winners, which requires a bear strategy, not this bull pullback.
